title: Missing Ping (League of Legends)
blurb: A short chirp and a question-mark bubble, and now the whole team knows your lane opponent has vanished. The enemy missing ping is League of Legends' most-used piece of communication and its most passive-aggressive: spam it at a jungler who is three camps away and you have delivered an entire paragraph without typing a word. Riot has rebuilt the ping wheel repeatedly over the years. The sound survived all of it. Outside the game it does honest work flagging that somebody has gone suspiciously quiet in a group chat.
origin: The enemy missing ping from League of Legends (Riot Games).
